Indian Police Disperse Congress Rally with Water Cannons

Indian police used water cannons to disperse a Congress party rally, the 'Hisab Maango' protest, at JMC. Thousands of youth protesters were involved in clashes with police. The incident occurred in downtown Los Angeles, where a federal officer also reportedly drew a gun during a separate confrontation with protesters.
